items.title: Limited Edition Lathe Cuts: The Great Crossing
items.description:
A limited edition of 25 professionally manufactured lathe cuts of The Great Crossing is now available on my Bandcamp page, including full-color artwork. Shipping starts on September 1st.

This is the first in a series of upcoming new releases in which I move into a slightly different musical direction. As an experiment, I will have small batches of on-demand lathe cuts made for these projects.

items.title: MY MUSICAL DIARY #2 (1986-1989)
items.description: On September 3rd, Concertzender airs part two of the twenty-part series showcasing the complete musical archive of Dutch composer and producer Maarten van der Vleuten (aka The Noise Architect, M.A.W.A. Inc., and many others). This episode features work from 1985 to 1987.

Concertzender is launching a twenty-part series based on my complete musical archive. In this first episode, you’ll hear my very first work as The Noise Architect and M.A.W.A. Inc., covering the period 1985–1989.
items.title: MY MUSICAL DIARY #1 (1985–1987)
New website live
items.description: My new official website is now live, with a fresh look and a growing catalogue of releases! You'll find a link to the legacy website at the top of every page.

items.title: MY MUSICAL DIARY #3 (1988-1992)
items.description: In this episode of Concertzender's Contemporary Music Night, I present part three of the twenty-part series showcasing my complete musical archive as a Dutch composer, producer, and Signum Recordings label owner (aka The Noise Architect, M.A.W.A. Inc., Major Malfunction, and many others). Tonight, I bring you selection of my works created between 1988 and 1992.
